business_summary: MS Concept Limited, an investment holding company, provides catering services through a chain of restaurants in Hong Kong. It owns and operates restaurants under the Mr. Steak  Buffet à la minute, The Palate, Mr. Steak, Sky Bar, Bistro Bloom, Hana, ??, Shokudo Wara, and Eat Home brands. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Hong Kong, Hong Kong. MS Concept Limited is a subsidiary of Future More Company Limited.

Mr. Steak Buffet à la Minute, The Palate, Mr. Steak, Sky Bar, Bistro Bloom, Hana, ??, Shokudo Wara 및 Eat Home 브랜드로 레스토랑을 소유 및 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 2000년에 설립되었으며 본사는 홍콩에 있습니다.
